newsitem.title: FRANCE: Algeria says a Bulgarian killed near Algiers.
newsitem.headline: Algeria says a Bulgarian killed near Algiers.

text.p: A Bulgarian man was killed overnight in Algiers, Algerian security forces announced on Saturday.
The security forces, in a statement carried by the official Algerian news agency APS, named the victim as Ivdimove Evtim, 56, and said he was killed in Hammamet, a northern suburb of Algiers.
The statement gave no details on the killing of the Bulgarian, who had been living in Algeria for several years.

More than 100 foreigners have been killed since 1993 in attacks officially blamed on Moslem guerrillas. Nearly 60,000 people have died in Algeria's violence since early 1992 when the authorities cancelled a general election in which Islamists had taken a commanding lead.
